title: Learning from Historical Transactions: Robust Supplier Pricing and Stocking with Sparse Data
summary: Upstream suppliers often set wholesale prices and stocking levels without direct access to detailed end-market demand information, which is instead held by downstream retailers. We study how a supplier can learn from a small number of historical transactions consisting of wholesale prices, retailer-chosen retail prices, and the resulting demand responses. We develop a robust, nonparametric framework that combines inverse optimization with distributionally robust optimization.
